hero.title:
Freshness

hero.subtitle: A wide selection of fresh, frozen and smoked fish, caviar and selected Russian and Eastern European delicacies. Quality, taste and personal preparation are at the heart of what we do.

product.title:
A wide choice
for every taste.
product.body:
Our fish range includes carp, gilt-head bream (dorade), sea bass (branzino), trout and salmon – whole or as fillet, depending on availability.

We also carry tuna fillet and tuna steaks, tilapia fillet, cod fillet, pike-perch fillet, silver carp, plaice fillet and hake (Oslić). Depending on the type of fish and availability, we offer them fresh or frozen.

hero.title:
One shop, one origin,
One conviction.

story.title:
A family business
With roots in Central Asia.
story.body: Fische & mehr is a small speciality shop in Vienna's 2nd district, run by a family with roots in Central Asia. With them came the conviction that fish has to be truly fresh — ideally live, straight from the tank. Alongside live and day-fresh fish we bring specialities from Uzbekistan, Tajikistan and the region to Vienna: things that taste of home. Today all of that lives behind the counter on Glockengasse — personally run, with advice like in the old days.

categories.title:
Far more
than just fish.
categories.intro: Discover a wide selection of popular specialities: pickled cucumbers, tomatoes, peppers, cabbage, mushrooms and garlic, plus courgette purée, Georgian-style peppers and mild aubergines with peppers. You'll also find classics such as Russian condensed milk, canned cod liver, sprats and other selected specialities. For everyone who loves traditional flavours – there's plenty here to delight.

items.q: Can I pre-order fish or fish platters?
items.a: Yes. On request we put together individual smoked-fish platters for any occasion and deliver them to you. Best in the shop or by phone, in good time.

items.q: What do you have besides fish?
items.a: Fish delicacies plus specialties from many countries: dried fruit, nuts, natural honey, spices, pickled vegetables, sweets and spirits.

items.q: Do you prepare the fish on site?
items.a: Yes. We prepare your fish in the shop just the way you like it and vacuum-seal it fresh for you.
Monday to Friday from 08:30 to 17:30. Closed Saturday and Sunday.

items.q: How do I get to you?
items.a: Glockengasse 22, 1020 Vienna — just a few minutes' walk from Taborstraße station, well connected by public transport.
There's currently no online shop. Come by or give us a call — we're happy to tell you what's fresh today.
